meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: 给已放进 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音:在音频元素上写效果链、自动化包络、人声 carve 等属性,处理淡入淡出、声轨增益与闪避。预览和渲染跑同一套 Web Audio 图,听到的就是最终写出的。
howto.when: 当已放置的音频需要淡入淡出、闪避或效果链等混音时接管;找 BGM、做配音交给 /media-use,片段时序与轨道排布交给 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给音乐轨加淡入淡出,并让它在人声出现时自动避让
say.note: 会在音乐元素上写 carve 与自动化

say.text: 把三段人声合成一个组,再让音乐对着这个组做 carve
say.note: 多个 clip 要先分组再 carve

say.text: 给人声加 80Hz 高通和压缩,最后挂一个 limiter 当上限
say.note: 按信号顺序写进效果链

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: writes fx chain, automation envelopes and voiceover carve attributes on elements, covering fade-in/out, track gain and ducking. Preview and render share one Web Audio graph.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio needs mixing — fades, ducking or an effects chain. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing and track layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Fade the music track in and out, and duck it under the voiceover
say_en.note: Writes carve plus automation on the music element

say_en.text: Group the three narration clips, then carve the music against that group
say_en.note: Multiple clips must be grouped before carving

say_en.text: Add an 80 Hz highpass and a compressor to the voice, then a limiter as ceiling
